title: Rate-Limit Plan
description: A structured rate-limiter design capturing the three decisions (algorithm, placement, key) plus failure-mode and response-contract hygiene, so this skill's Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/rate_limiting_strategy_audit.mjs.

algorithm.description: The limiting algorithm. sliding-window-counter is the general-purpose default.

customerFacing.description: True if the limited surface serves external customers (boundary-burst and NAT-collision rules apply).

burstsRequired.description: True if legitimate clients need controlled bursts above the steady rate (CI runs, batch imports).

enforcementPoints.description: Where the limiter runs. The usual correct answer is edge + origin-redis in series.

replicaCount.description: Number of app replicas/pods. An in-process limiter multiplies the effective limit by this.

keyTier.description: The primary key the limit is bucketed by (tier 1 = user-id is best for product limits).

authEndpointsCovered.description: True if /login, /register, /forgot-password have their own tight limits distinct from read endpoints.

loginKeyTuples.description: Which tuples the login limiter counts simultaneously. All three are required to block both rotation and spraying.

atomicLua.description: True if all Redis limiter logic runs in a single EVAL/EVALSHA Lua script (atomic read-modify-write).

redisCluster.description: True if the backing Redis is a Cluster deployment.

clusterHashTags.description: True if multi-key limiter keys use {tag} hash tags so one principal's keys share a slot.

rateLimitHeaders.description: True if RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset (IETF draft) headers are emitted.

redisFailureMode.description: The documented behavior when Redis is unreachable. undecided fails the audit.

failOpenTelemetry.description: True if every fail-open allow emits a metric with alerting. Required when redisFailureMode is fail-open.

perEndpointLimits.description: True if limits are differentiated by endpoint cost/risk rather than one global policy.

unauthenticatedTraffic.description: True if the API serves unauthenticated traffic (which should be dropped at the edge).
